scope_notes: Support final evidence parsed directly from the last provider request search_knowledge tool messages. Source equality uses fixture source ID and SHA-256 over exact UTF-8 snippet. Retrieved occurrences count repeats.
thread_turns stores agent_run_id, not an independent final_output. Compare the DB Run text to both frozen Turn and Run views and independently join actual persisted Turn and Run.

Elapsed times are frozen task elapsed times, not model-only latency. System extension and observation field metrics are archived request token estimates. Physical input and output totals come from the physical receipts.
No semantic judgments or model calls. Event-log completeness is recorded separately from terminal state.
